title: Molecular Dynamics Simulations Combined with Markov Model to Explore the Effect of Allosteric Inhibitor Binding on Bromodomain-Containing Protein 4.
authors: Yang, Xiaotang; Gao, Yilin; Cao, Fuyan; Wang, Song
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟和马尔可夫模型研究BRD4蛋白的变构抑制剂结合机制，对象是蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法虽为物理模拟但与本课题TF-DNA结合体系无关。
abstract: Bromodomain-Containing Protein 4 (BRD4) can play an important role in gene transcriptional regulation of tumor development and survival by participating in histone modification epigenetic mechanism. Although it has been reported that novel allosteric inhibitors such as ZL0590 have a high affinity with target protein BRD4 and good efficacy, their inhibitory mechanism has not been studied further. The aim of this study was to reveal the inhibition mechanism of allosteric inhibitor ZL0590 on Free-BRD4 and BRD4 binding MS436 (orthosteric inhibitor) by molecular dynamics simulation combined with a Markov model. Our results showed that BRD4-ZL0590 led to alpha-helices formation of 100-105 compared with Free-BRD4; the combination of MS436 caused residues 30-40 and 95-105 to form alpha-helices, while the combination of allosteric inhibitors untangled the alpha-helices formed by the MS436. The results of Markov flux analysis showed that the binding process of inhibitors mainly involved changes in the degree of alpha-helices at ZA loop. The binding of ZL0590 reduced the distance between ZA loop and BC loop, blocked the conformation at the active site, and inhibited the binding of MS436. After the allosteric inhibitor binding, the MS436 that could normally penetrate into the interior of the pocket was floating on the edge of the active pocket and did not continue to penetrate into the active pocket as expected. In summary, we provide a theoretical basis for the inhibition mechanism of ZL0590 against BRD4, which can be used as a reference for improving the development of drug targets for cancer therapy.
abstract_zh: 含溴结构域蛋白4（BRD4）可通过参与组蛋白修饰表观遗传机制，在肿瘤发展和存活的基因转录调控中发挥重要作用。尽管已有报道称新型变构抑制剂如ZL0590与靶蛋白BRD4具有高亲和力且疗效良好，但其抑制机制尚未得到进一步研究。本研究旨在通过分子动力学模拟结合马尔可夫模型，揭示变构抑制剂ZL0590对Free-BRD4及BRD4结合MS436（正构抑制剂）的抑制机制。我们的结果表明，与Free-BRD4相比，BRD4-ZL0590导致100-105位残基形成α-螺旋；MS436的结合使30-40位和95-105位残基形成α-螺旋，而变构抑制剂的结合则解开了由MS436形成的α-螺旋。马尔可夫通量分析结果显示，抑制剂的结合过程主要涉及ZA环处α-螺旋程度的变化。ZL0590的结合缩短了ZA环与BC环之间的距离，阻断了活性位点的构象，并抑制了MS436的结合。变构抑制剂结合后，原本能正常穿透进入口袋内部的MS436漂浮在活性口袋边缘，并未如预期那样继续深入活性口袋。总之，我们为ZL0590对BRD4的抑制机制提供了理论基础，可作为改进癌症治疗药物靶点开发的参考。
